q: In the Anthropic Messages API, what tells your loop that the model wants a tool run?
options: The model returns an empty message
explain: The stop reason says why generation stopped; `tool_use` means the content includes one or more tool requests.

q: A tool raises an exception mid-run. What should a well-built harness usually do?
options: Crash the run so a human notices
Return the error to the model as a tool result marked as an error
explain: Errors are information. Returning them lets the model recover, while budgets prevent endless retries.

q: Why does the total input-token cost of an agent run grow faster than the number of turns?
options: Models charge more per token later in a conversation
Each call re-sends the entire history, so later calls read everything before them
The system prompt grows each turn
explain: Summing a growing history across calls gives roughly quadratic growth, which is why caching and compaction matter.

q: Which exit must every production agent loop have, besides the model ending its turn?
options: A step or cost budget enforced in code
A second model that approves every step
explain: Without a hard budget, a confused model can loop until your bill or your users notice.
